state: initial construction; no generator or source replay executed by builder
feedback_schedule: Controller freezes all three initial candidates before any source replay; returns complete source-only feedback for all structures together; at most one parent-linked revise/retain per structure. All final structures are evaluated; no source-score winner selection.

families.name: Additive conditional arithmetic mean with lognormal individual noise
families.scientific_difference: One raw-scale BMI slope and sex-specific linear age slopes; constant residual CV. Effects add in arithmetic mean, so BMI slope remains constant away from positive regularization.
families.source_compatible_in_principle: Oh reduced slope and sex-specific moments directly anchor the local mean and residual variance. Female age increase and positive skew can accommodate the Bansal location/rank summaries without treating their marginal correlations as conditional coefficients.
families.assumption_limits: Linear age response, no raw-mean interaction, distribution transport and independent source covariates are not identified by the sources. Positive floor affects unsupported low-mean combinations.
families.planned_diagnostic_tradeoffs: Raw-scale OLS may agree while TG quantile asymmetry, rare tails or female age-TG rank correlation and tertile ages disagree; increasing CV changes both tail mass and rank associations.

families.name: Saturating multiplicative log-location model with smooth female age transition
families.scientific_difference: BMI enters a bounded nonlinear function of log TG; female age enters a sigmoid. Arithmetic-scale BMI effects depend on age/sex and saturate at high BMI.
families.source_compatible_in_principle: Positive skew, Table 2 qualitative female age transition and high-BMI flattening, plus Bansal fasting quantiles motivate this alternative. Source moment-equivalent medians and approximate local slope anchor it.
families.assumption_limits: The plateau width and age transition are unreported; they are not measured menopausal state. One lognormal family may miss observed extreme tail/category counts. Marginal-to-conditional centering is approximate.
families.planned_diagnostic_tradeoffs: May better represent age curvature and TG quantiles while changing raw-scale BMI OLS, sex-specific SDs and high-BMI extrapolation. Same source diagnostics expose these tradeoffs without selecting endpoints.

families.name: Latent elevated-TG state mixture with gamma components
families.scientific_difference: Age/BMI alter state membership instead of a single continuous TG location; conditional dispersion and tails change with mixture composition, and mean response saturates.
families.source_compatible_in_principle: Source TG spread, skew and metabolic clustering permit latent heterogeneity; two gamma states can represent low and elevated ranges while using the same moment and local-slope anchors. This is compatibility in principle only, not evidence that two biological classes exist.
families.assumption_limits: State prevalence/components are not identified by aggregate source statistics. State is not a diagnosis. Analytic logistic-normal centering is approximate and can leave mean/slope discrepancies.
families.planned_diagnostic_tradeoffs: Could reproduce moderate/high category fractions while distorting median/IQR, rare extreme tail or age/BMI distributions inside TG tertiles. Rank relationships may differ even with similar marginal moments.

uncertainty: Fixed-source, fixed-covariate, fixed-parameter scenarios do not give calibrated probabilities over scientific structures. Missing source joint distributions remain unknown. Source numerical agreement will not establish target validity or causal or individual recovery claims.
